rules.definition: PRIMARY. Pooled L2 logistic regression (lambda=10, Newton) over (draw,number) rows; features L1..L10 last-10-draw indicators, freq last 20, freq all, gap(min 10)/10, position in last draw order, + 22 number dummies; standardized; refit every 10 draws on targets 10..R-1; ticket = 11 lowest prob.
Per-number L2 logistic regression (22 models, lambda=10, Newton); same 14 lag features + 7 weekday dummies of target draw; refit every 10 draws; ticket = 11 lowest prob.

Gradient-boosted stumps (pooled, 100 rounds, lr 0.1, leaf L2=1, min 20 rows/side, <=16 thresholds) on 14 lag features + 22 number dummies + 7 weekday dummies; refit every 10 draws; ticket = 11 lowest prob.
